statement: KEEP 2026-09-16 (path C): the mapping capability was never removed. entity_mapping_queue is still written by the live pipeline at apps/api/app/ingestion/pipeline.py:185 (EntityMappingQueue on unmatched product) and carries resolution state ImportRowResult does not. "Restore vs retire the mapping-queue UI" is therefore a void premise. KEEP: the queue stays. It is pipeline state, not a UI to restore or retire. Destination is governed by D-066: mapping and steward work finishes at /admin/mappings?workspace=resolve for every type including shipment. Per-job engines remain the resolver. Supersedes D-0006 (accepted deferral of D-0002) and D-0002 (RESTORE vs RETIRE proposed).
